rationale: Positives: The agent properly verified identity using full name + ZIP, looked up the correct orders, provided the correct tablet tracking number, attempted an exchange (which was unavailable), then obtained explicit confirmation before initiating the tablet return. For the charger (pending), the agent requested a reason and then canceled with refund appropriately. Actions were taken only on the authenticated user’s orders, and details matched tool outputs. Issue: When the user asked to return the sneakers, the agent executed the return immediately without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Because of this confirmation lapse, the conversation does not meet the pass bar even though outcomes were otherwise correct.
